UNUC Legal LLP | International Arbitration Desk

UNUC Legal LLP is pleased to introduce its International Arbitration Desk, bringing together legal, engineering, commercial and project expertise to support complex India-related and cross-border disputes.

The Desk works alongside international counsel, foreign law firms and clients, providing support in Indian law, arbitration proceedings and enforcement of arbitral awards in India.

Our international presence extends across Singapore, the United Kingdom, France, Switzerland, Sweden, the Netherlands, Austria, Spain, Denmark, the United Arab Emirates and Malaysia, with experience across leading arbitration frameworks including ICC, LCIA, SCC, SIAC, HKIAC, DIAC and ad hoc arbitration.

With a particular focus on EPC, infrastructure, construction, energy, maritime and commercial disputes, UNUC Legal LLP brings a techno-legal perspective to matters where legal, contractual, technical and project considerations intersect.

We welcome opportunities to collaborate with international law firms, arbitration practitioners, counsel and institutions on matters involving India and Indian interests.
